content.text: As a digital creator in Zimbabwe or other countries with restricted access to Stripe or PayPal, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-ebooks-without-paypal-honest-side-side-breakdown-15|selling]] ebooks and digital products online can be a daunting task. The absence of reliable [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-what-actually-how-7|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-16|USDT Payment]] processing options forces many to rely on workarounds, hindering their ability to scale and grow their business. However, with the advent of sovereign digital commerce stacks, creators can now bypass conventional platforms and sell their products directly to customers, leveraging the power of cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-15. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

The sovereign digital commerce stack is designed to give creators full control over their sales process, from product delivery to payment processing. By utilizing free and paid tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments, you can create a fully operational online store without relying on restrictive platforms like Gumroad or Payhip. This infrastructure is particularly beneficial for creators who sell digital products like ebooks, courses, and templates, as it allows them to maintain ownership of their customer data and sales pipeline.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack, you need to have a clear understanding of your product offerings, target audience, and sales strategy. You should also have a basic understanding of cryptocurrencies and how they work. Additionally, you will need to set up a digital wallet to receive payments and configure your NOWPayments account to accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies. With these prerequisites in place, you can begin building your stack and deploying your online store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is a critical step in deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack. You will need to configure your NOWPayments account to accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies, and set up a system for automated product delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This will ensure that customers receive their digital products instantly after making a payment, and that you can track and manage your sales effectively. With a 0.5% fee, NOWPayments offers a cost-effective solution compared to platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% on every sale.
Sovereign digital commerce stacks give creators full control over their sales process and customer data.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you have set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you can go live with your online store and start processing transactions. It's essential to test your setup thoroughly to ensure that everything is working as expected. You should also have a plan in place for handling customer support and refunds, in case any issues arise. With your sovereign digital commerce stack up and running, you can focus on marketing and promoting your products to attract more customers and grow your business.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your business grows, you may need to scale your infrastructure to handle increased traffic and sales. This can involve upgrading your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script setup, or adding more products to your online store. With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you have full control over your infrastructure and can make changes as needed to ensure that your business continues to run smoothly. By leveraging the power of cryptocurrencies and automated delivery, you can focus on creating more value for your customers and expanding your product offerings.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can use a sovereign digital commerce stack that leverages cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and automated delivery. This setup allows you to maintain full control over your sales process and customer data, while also avoiding platform fees. With NOWPayments, you can accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee, compared to Gumroad's 10% fee. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921, making it a cost-effective solution for digital creators.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% on every sale, compared to Gumroad's 10% fee.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to build and deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, consider purchasing the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates. You can find more information about this and other products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. By investing in a comprehensive solution, you can create a reliable and scalable infrastructure for selling digital products and growing your business.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: set up your digital wallet and configure your NOWPayments account, create a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages site for your online store, configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automated product delivery, add your products to the online store and set prices in USD, test your setup thoroughly to ensure everything is working as expected, and go live with your online store and start processing transactions. By following these steps, you can create a fully operational online store and start selling digital products directly to customers.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between Gumroad and NOWPayments?
Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments charges 0.5%. This significant difference in fees can result in substantial savings for digital creators.
Can I use my existing website with a sovereign digital commerce stack?

Yes, you can integrate your existing website with a sovereign digital commerce stack by using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automated product delivery and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payments.
How do I handle customer support and refunds?
You should have a plan in place for handling customer support and refunds, including a system for tracking and responding to customer inquiries and a process for issuing refunds when necessary.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT, allowing you to accept a wide range of payments from customers.
How do I scale my infrastructure as my business grows?

You can scale your infrastructure by upgrading your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script setup, adding more products to your online store, or investing in additional tools and services to support your growing business.
With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can sell digital products directly to customers and avoid platform fees.
